title: Profile Anatomy
brief: A clean file-tree infographic titled 'Profile 解剖'. Center: a folder tree rooted at '~/.hermes/profiles/researcher/' showing these entries: SOUL.md (annotation: 人格), config.yaml (模型·工具·全部设置), .env (密钥与 bot token), profile.yaml (身份元数据 / Bot 花名册展示), memories/ folder containing MEMORY.md and USER.md (记忆——与 SOUL.md 同级的身份), skills/ (能力), sessions/ (对话历史), state.db (SQLite 状态库), cron/ (定时任务), logs/ (日志). Each entry has a thin leader line to a small Chinese annotation label. A side note panel: 'hermes -p researcher chat → 直接进入这位 agent', and a badge 'HERMES_HOME → 指向这个目录'. Flat vector infographic, cream background, terracotta orange and ink blue accents, monospace English filenames, Chinese annotation labels, generous spacing, no clutter.
